name: teamwork-task
description: Fetch Teamwork.com tasklist/task by URL, implement each task in the current repo, commit per task using TYPE(scope): Message convention, and log time back to Teamwork. For tasklist URLs the skill filters tasks down to the ones in the board column 'To Do' (case-sensitive) AND assigned to the current user — every other task is still analysed and discussed, but skipped from actual implementation (so a Laravel-backend developer working on a multi-repo project does not accidentally implement the iOS / Ionic teammate's tasks). Single-task URLs bypass the filter on purpose. v1.4.0: parent tasks with subtasks are expanded into a flat working list — each subtask is fetched, planned, implemented, committed, board-moved (In progress → Internal testing) and time-logged independently, exactly like a standalone task; the same 'To Do + assigned to me' filter applies per-subtask. Pulls task attachments and comments, scans the local working tree for unattached specs/samples (e.g. `Strečnianska/DNR.docx`), pauses with a question when a task explicitly says it needs an external input that is not yet available, auto-moves the task across the board (In progress → Internal testing), gates risky commits for review, and writes sequential time logs that pick up where your last Teamwork timelog ended. When the companion `teamwork-task-test` plugin is installed, auto-invokes it at the end of the run so each task's acceptance criteria get individually verified before push.
